featured.name: TruckersMP's Halloween Convoy
featured.description:
### Our Halloween Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**!  

  The event takes place on the **31st October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---

   ### **Information** 
   
   We will take to the roads of ETS2 in the dead of night during the witching hour. 
   Are you brave enough to enter? Who knows what might be lurking in the shadows!  
   
   You can find all the details via our [Blog Post](link)  
   
   ### :parking: | **Parking** 
   
   > You may park at any company available in **Paris** with a **no collision zone**. 
   
   ![Convoy Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/40c74b71-7a64-47ba-9bc4-a65bdfab5293.avif)
featured.rule:

* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
* Triple trailer and HCT trailer configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Double trailer configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Cars are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
* Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* Overtaking is prohibited.
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.  
All other TruckersMP rules apply.  

Event Rules for Event Staff
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.

All other TruckersMP rules apply.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!

## INTERNATIONAL ARBOR´S DAY LTR CONVOY!
- LTR Konvoj k mezinárodnímu dni stromů!

-----
## [FOUNDATIONS // CHARITY](https://linkmix.co/61032859)

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/Bq04VnP.jpeg)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
4. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
5. The CARGO is restricted for the Bags of Seeds.
6. Only Electric Trucks are allowed, please download on the link.

-----


![](https://i.imgur.com/J4n18kZ.png)

* 1. **Download the .exe** file from the official links - [PUBLIC](https://bit.ly/ltr_01) // [VTC LTR](https://bit.ly/ltr_02) (password in Private Chat).
* 2. Open the .exe file and allow the instalation.
* 3. **Switch profile in TruckersMP to "LTR Electric Event"** and launch the game.
* 4. Simply do your settings and you´re set to go!

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **19:30** - Meet at the parking slots in Venice.
*  **20:00**  - Departure from Venice.
*  **21:00**- Passage trough wonderful Swiss Alpen Road.
*  **21:20** - Passage trough the historic city of Bern.
*  **21:30** - Arrival to the Bern, RT Log and end of event.


![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/Hh5mzNO.png)

**1. Venice, LKW (Slots) - Bern, RT Log.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*

Bu konvoyda tüm TruckersMP kuralları geçerlidir. 🧭
Lütfen güvenli ve keyifli bir sürüş için aşağıdaki ek kurallara da dikkat ediniz:

🚫 Cars (Arabalar) Kullanmak Yasaktır.

All TruckersMP rules apply during this event. 🧭
Please follow the additional rules below to ensure a safe and enjoyable convoy:

🚫 Overtaking is strictly forbidden.
🚫 Cars (Scout vehicles) are not allowed.
🚫 Scout vehicles are reserved only for Event Staff.
🚫 Trolling, spamming, sudden braking, or rule violations will result in removal.
🚫 Do not overspeed, follow the convoy leader’s pace.
🚫 No horn or high beam spam.
🚫 Keep CB Radio clear and avoid unnecessary chatter.
✅ Maintain safe distance from the truck ahead.
✅ Always follow Event Staff and NIGHT | CC (Convoy Control) instructions.

Drivers who fail to comply with these rules may be removed from the event.
Let’s enjoy a safe, respectful, and fun convoy! 🚛💨
